newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil rebounds at close on friendly data.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil rebounds at close on friendly data.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - A supportive crop report by Ivan Wong helped prices to rebound at close. Prices were initially lower because of weaker soyoil prices and thereafter drifted in tight ranges. April hovered steadily above the 1,250 ringgit level.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Moved in line with futures. Activity was seen among nearby crude palm oil and RBD palm olein.
The underlying sentiment appears steady and the market is speculating a double-digit fall in the output because of the wet conditions in East Malaysia.
Wong has projected palm oil exports in January at 545,000 tonnes and stocks at the end of January at 730,000 tonnes against market expectation of 750,000 tonnes.
Morning prices drifted narrowly in morning session with lack of big participation limiting activity, traders said.
The market initially eased in line with falls in Chicago soyoil futures overnight, they said.
April futures held steadily at above 1,250 ringgit level. At the close, the contract was up nine ringgit at 1,255 ringgit ($505.44) a tonne.
Traders expect the next resistance at 1,270 with support at 1,250. Turnover on the futures market was 1,853 lots.
Physical Jan (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,340 against bids at 1,332.50, after trading at 1,325 and 1.330.
Jan (central) was offered at 1,330 and bids at 1,322.50, and Jan (north) at 1,315 against 1,305.
Feb (south) saw offers at 1,337.50 with bids at 1,330 with earlier trades of 1,325 and 1,330, and Feb (central) was offered at 1,325 against 1,312.50.
Among refined products, Feb RBD palm oil was offered at $560 a tonne FOB Malaysia and Mar at $555.
Feb RBD palm olein saw offers at $595, Mar at $585 and Apr/May/Jun at $575. Mar was traded at $576 and Apr/May/Jun at $567.50.
Feb/Mar RBD palm stearin was offered at $432.50 and Feb/Mar palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $300.
